title: Combining Search and Vector Retrieval — practice
prompt: You are working on “Combining Search and Vector Retrieval” in a dedicated MongoDB practice environment. Which next step best demonstrates the skill while keeping the result reviewable?
objective: Apply combining search and vector retrieval and verify its result safely.

options: Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Create a tiny labeled retrieval dataset, define the required search/vector index, run representative queries, and evaluate relevance and metadata filters in the actual supported deployment.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.

expected_output: Create a tiny labeled retrieval dataset, define the required search/vector index, run representative queries, and evaluate relevance and metadata filters in the actual supported deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Choose an approach that directly addresses the stated MongoDB topic.
State the expected outcome and one verification step.
Respect the disposable-lab, security and version/deployment assumptions.
hints: Identify the data or operational behavior the task needs to demonstrate.
Use a small reproducible example and write down the expected result before running it.
Review an official reference and test one boundary or failure case.

grading_config.correct_answer: Create a tiny labeled retrieval dataset, define the required search/vector index, run representative queries, and evaluate relevance and metadata filters in the actual supported deployment.

retry_policy.feedback: Review the related lesson, compare your choice with the verification hints, and retry. Incorrect attempts do not award XP.
